symbols.name: prime length
symbols.meaning: The prime number that is the length of the sequence z, the count of its complex entries.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the length of a sequence $z=(z_0,\dots,z_{q-1})$ of complex numbers.

symbols.name: input sequence
symbols.meaning: The sequence of q complex numbers that the transform acts on; on the synthetic transform page the same letter names a second sequence.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the length of a sequence $z=(z_0,\dots,z_{q-1})$ of complex numbers.

symbols.name: normalized transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized discrete Fourier transform of length q.
symbols.quote: Gaussian resampling rewrites the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) $F_q$ of length $q$ as a transform over power-of-two axes.

symbols.name: source transform length
symbols.meaning: The length of the source transform, the count of entries of the sequences it acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $s<t$ be integers, the lengths of the source and target transforms, with $\gcd(s,t)=1$ and $t$ a power of two; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.name: target transform length
symbols.meaning: The length of the target transform, a power of two, which is the count of its entries.
symbols.quote: Let $s<t$ be integers, the lengths of the source and target transforms, with $\gcd(s,t)=1$ and $t$ a power of two; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.name: normalized source transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized discrete Fourier transform of length s.
symbols.quote: Let $F_s$ and $F_t$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_s$ and $F_t$.

symbols.name: normalized target transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized discrete Fourier transform of length t.
symbols.quote: Let $F_s$ and $F_t$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_s$ and $F_t$.

symbols.name: source permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation of the outputs of the source transform.
symbols.quote: Let $F_s$ and $F_t$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_s$ and $F_t$.

symbols.name: target permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation of the outputs of the target transform.
symbols.quote: Let $F_s$ and $F_t$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_s$ and $F_t$.

symbols.name: identity constant
symbols.meaning: A power of two that is the same for all s and t, the constant factor of the identity.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be a power of two, the same for all $s$ and $t$

symbols.name: first contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the space of length-s sequences to the space of length-t sequences.
symbols.quote: Here $L_1:\mathbb C^s\to\mathbb C^t$ and $L_2:\mathbb C^t\to\mathbb C^s$ are linear contractions, maps that do not increase the size of a vector.

symbols.name: second contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the space of length-t sequences to the space of length-s sequences.
symbols.quote: Here $L_1:\mathbb C^s\to\mathbb C^t$ and $L_2:\mathbb C^t\to\mathbb C^s$ are linear contractions, maps that do not increase the size of a vector.

relations.quote: Gaussian resampling rewrites the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) $F_q$ of length $q$ as a transform over power-of-two axes.

relations.predicate: operates on the axes produced by
relations.quote: Gaussian resampling operates on the axes produced by the [Chinese-remainder address map](chinese-remainder-address-map.md).
Gaussian resampling is carried over by [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) to several axes: tensor products give the same identity for multidimensional transforms.
